name: Anime API
description: Independent anime metadata and source API for NuvioTV. Resolves AniList or TMDB episodes through the Anime API and returns Sub/Dub/DL streams plus external subtitle tracks. The plugin never scrapes or bypasses Cloudflare; source discovery stays server-side and the optional AnimePahe provider is disabled by default.
author: Nuvio Community

scrapers.name: Anime API
scrapers.description: Authorized anime streams from your own Anime API deployment (Sub/Dub/DL)
